object_description: A pre-execution instrument design whose candidate, input channels, gold construction, authorship and evaluator may share information that makes the reported outcome self-authored or otherwise construct-dependent.
qoi: Whether the frozen design may spend an outcome-bearing epoch without reading the target through a shared answer channel, shared author, candidate-derived gold, or a statistic that survives its registered permutation/null control.
assumptions: an undeclared obligation is an unrun check and yields CANNOT_CHECK
author and channel identities are explicit frozen inputs
gold construction is judged at a frozen evaluator epoch
null/permutation evidence is produced on known-answer or development fixtures before confirmatory outcome access

strongest_parents.justification: Existing fail-closed pre-execution gate for a different admissibility question: whether the instrument can express an effect above its MDE.
Existing internal practice for proving a gate can fail under registered hostile fixtures.
Merged #729 provides a fresh internal example where predeclared construct-independence obligations invalidated an ascent-friendly discriminator outcome.

prior_art_equivalence_map: adaptive holdout reuse and evaluation overfitting
oracle_or_lower_bound: Known-answer fixtures inject exactly one dependency at a time. The conformance oracle is exact: a clean design must be ADMISSIBLE; planted shared-channel, same-author, candidate-derived-gold, or permutation-surviving designs must not be admitted. This oracle establishes gate discrimination only, not scientific validity of real instruments.
minimal_counterexamples: gold is computed from the candidate prediction
renderer exposes an answer-bearing field consumed by the extractor
generator and evaluator share the same author identity without separation
reported signal survives the registered label permutation/null
one obligation is omitted but silently treated as pass
all obligations are declared yet a planted dependency is admitted
falsifier: Over the next 12 instrument closures, designs that satisfy all four frozen obligations do not have a lower construct-defect rate than designs that do not, or a planted construct-dependent known-world fixture is admitted.
same_system_ablation: Hold the instrument/evaluator fixed and violate or omit exactly one independence obligation at a time.
total_cost_equation: admission_cost = declaration_review + identity/provenance checks + known-answer/null-control execution
novelty_residual: A reusable fail-closed construct-independence admission object composed beside the existing ceiling and falsifiability gates, with no new authority path.
permitted_publication_claim: Only conformance until the frozen forward falsifier executes: the gate rejects registered construct-dependent fixtures and records missing obligations as CANNOT_CHECK.
